ping.api: System.Net.NetworkInformation.Ping.SendPingAsync(IPAddress, Int32, Byte[]), one Ping per target, all sent before any is awaited (Task.WaitAll)
ping.kept: the reply Status by IPStatus name and RoundtripTime in milliseconds when Status is Success; a faulted send is error with its innermost exception type; a send still pending after the wait is not_completed

dns.name: www.microsoft.com
dns.kept: answered or failed, the number of records returned (never the records), and for a failure the exception type, the FullyQualifiedErrorId when it has the documented error id shape (else withheld) and the NativeErrorCode when the exception has one
dns.timing: qpc_done - qpc_after spans the cmdlet call, so it is an upper bound on the query time

session.slot_rule: slot k is due at the session start counter plus k seconds; a slot reached more than one interval late is written as a missed line and not taken late
session.stamp: qpc_before, filetime_utc_100ns, qpc_after are read right before the probe is sent (Stopwatch.GetTimestamp, DateTime.UtcNow.ToFileTimeUtc, Stopwatch.GetTimestamp); qpc_done right after it completed
session.samples_file: samples.jsonl, one JSON object per line in the order written; a decoder cites line:<n>
session.network_traffic: the probes are packets this PC sends: one ICMP echo of 32 bytes per target per slot and one DNS A query per DNS target every 10 slots; no setting is read for writing or changed
session.privacy: the gateway address is read from the route table into memory and written only as the label gateway; the public targets are constants of the collector; no local address, hardware address, network name, adapter name or description, DNS answer or exception message is written
